items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: I was on that session. "Sister Kate."

ctx.x: Yeah. I was on that session. "Sister Kate."

Let's talk about the experience of recording. Apparently, you hadn't made recordings after King Oliver... Well, there may be some that you can tell me about. First of all, did you make any records after King Oliver and up to the time you recorded with Art Hodes? Or you didn't record at all?
